title: Structured document
description: Input of a structured-document job: semantic blocks that are rendered into a tagged PDF. Structure is declared, never inferred: headings, table headers, image descriptions and languages are stated by the author. Checks that a schema cannot express (heading order, empty table headers, missing image descriptions, language tags, font names) are made by the validator in addition to this schema.

title.description: Document title, at least one non-whitespace character. Written to the PDF title metadata and shown by viewers in the window title.

language.description: Primary language of the document as a BCP 47 tag, for example uk, en or en-US. Checked by the validator (code LANGUAGE_INVALID).

page.description: Page setup. Every property is optional.

margins.description: Margin on all four sides, for example 20mm. Default 20mm.

theme.description: Typography and colour. Every property is optional.

font.description: Body font. One of the bundled fonts: Noto Sans, Noto Serif, Noto Sans Arabic, Noto Sans Hebrew. Checked by the validator (code FONT_UNKNOWN). Default Noto Sans.

fontSize.description: Body font size in points. Default 11.

accent.description: Accent colour of headings and table header rows as #rrggbb. Default #1a1a1a.

header.description: Blocks repeated at the top of every page. Headings here are decoration and do not take part in the heading order.

footer.description: Blocks repeated at the bottom of every page. May contain a pageNumber block. Headings here do not take part in the heading order.

body.description: The document content in reading order.

length.description: A non-negative length with a unit: mm, cm, in or pt, for example 8mm.

url.description: A link target. Only http, https and mailto addresses are allowed; whitespace, including a trailing newline, is refused.

link.description: A hyperlink. The text must describe the target and must not be blank.

text.description: Visible link text. Blank text is reported by the validator (code LINK_TEXT_EMPTY).

inline.description: A piece of running text: a plain string, strong text, emphasised text or a link.

ordered.description: True for a numbered list. Default false (bulleted).

listItem.description: One list item: inline pieces of text, optionally followed by one nested list as the last element.

oneOf.description: A nested list. Only meaningful as the last element of an item.

cells.description: Table rows, each an array of cell texts.

block.description: A block of the document. The type property selects the kind.

oneOf.description: A heading. The first heading in the body must be level 1 or 2 and each later heading at most one level deeper than the previous one.

text.description: Heading text, at least one non-whitespace character.

content.description: Inline pieces of text in order.

lang.description: Language of this paragraph as a BCP 47 tag when it differs from the document language. Checked by the validator (code LANGUAGE_INVALID).

font.description: Font of this paragraph when it differs from the theme font, for example Noto Sans Arabic for Arabic text. Must be a bundled font name (code FONT_UNKNOWN).

ordered.description: True for a numbered list. Default false (bulleted).

oneOf.description: A data table with a caption and at least one header row. Header cells are tagged as headers.

caption.description: What the table shows, at least one non-whitespace character. Read by assistive technology before the table.

header.description: Header rows. At least one row with at least one non-blank cell (code TABLE_HEADER_EMPTY). The first header row sets the column count: every other header row and every body row must have the same number of cells (code TABLE_ROW_LENGTH_MISMATCH).

rowHeaders.description: True when the first cell of every body row is a row header. Default false.

columnAlign.description: Horizontal alignment per column, left to right. Must have one entry per column when present (code TABLE_ROW_LENGTH_MISMATCH).

oneOf.description: An image. Needs exactly one source (uploadId or file) and either a non-blank alt or decorative true; a missing description is reported with code IMAGE_ALT_MISSING.

uploadId.description: Identifier of an uploaded image file.

file.description: Path of an image file relative to the document, for the command-line tool only. Absolute paths, drive letters, backslashes and .. segments are refused.

alt.description: Description of the image for people who cannot see it. Mutually exclusive with decorative.

decorative.description: True when the image carries no information and is hidden from assistive technology. Mutually exclusive with alt.

oneOf.description: A paragraph that consists of one link.

text.description: Visible link text. Blank text is reported by the validator (code LINK_TEXT_EMPTY).

oneOf.description: Vertical space. Not announced by assistive technology.

height.description: Height of the space, for example 8mm.

oneOf.description: Label and value pairs, for example the parties of an invoice.

footerBlock.description: A footer block: any block, or a page number that the renderer fills in on every page.
